notes: Smooth white sheet (felt read as fleece, flannel as pyjamas). Tall dome with a forward brow carrying two big ink eye holes; the kid peeks out of the round 'boo' mouth. Sheet hem hitched up over the bucket arm. wing_l/wing_r = sheet flaps behind the arms, spread like ghost arms in the glide pose (sheets/kid_ghost_glide.png). No tail.

crow_blue (blue-black) felt so it survives the night lighting; pink-lined ears, yellow-green slit-pupil hood eyes, face-paint whiskers and nose, grey belly patch, orange collar + gold bell, paw boots, long S tail with an orange bow.

No hood: the kid's own hair (bare_head) with pigtails, under a big floppy hat whose tip flops sideways (height 1.36 m with the hat). wing_l/wing_r = cape halves, dark plum outside, orange lining and hem band; they open like wings in the glide pose.

Skull hood with a lower face opening (skull's toothy mouth framing the kid's eyes/cheeks/smile) so the sockets and nose sit on a forward brow; sockets on the crown read as a panda (passes 1-4). Bone print front and back (ribs on both sides so the gameplay camera sees it).

Ribbed pumpkin body narrowed in X (0.222 m) so both hands stay outside it; felt jack face; leafy collar; green beanie with stem, leaves and tendril. wing_l/wing_r = two pumpkin leaves standing off the back, splayed near level so the game's spread pose lifts them into a V.
